payingUser: A saz, baglama or oud player who already uses a free ad-funded niche tuner and is tired of two things: full-screen ads cutting a tuning session short, and the microtonal makam intervals (komma, perde offsets) being rounded away by equal-tempered software.
paidUnit: One in-app purchase that unlocks every traditional tuning (Kara Duzen, Baglama Duzeni, Misket, oud and makam sets), the perde/komma fret reference, the sustained drone tone generator, and removes all advertising for the life of the install.
momentOfPayment: At the moment the player first reaches for something the free tier does not read: a non-equal temperament tuning, the drone, or simply wants a tuning session that no ad can interrupt.
distinctnessSentence: One paid tuner that reads the makam intervals in cents and keeps a stable lock on the low saz and oud courses while never showing an ad, with every traditional tuning included in a single one-time $4.99 unlock instead of split across a $15/week subscription or a full-screen ad every thirty seconds.
day1RevenuePath: The app installs free with the tuner and one standard tuning usable, is listed against the saz tuner, baglama tuner and oud tuner queries where the two 1M+ incumbents sit at only 4.2 and 4.4 stars, and offers the single unlock the first time the player opens a microtonal tuning, the drone, or an ad-free session.
assumptionsUnverified: The 2% install-to-unlock conversion is an assumption carried from docs/monetization-strategy.md; no slot in this repository has ever measured a real install-to-purchase rate.
Play install counts are rounded buckets and the review sample is Play's own three-per-page selection, so the true size of the pocket and the frequency of each complaint are unmeasured.
No trademark screen of the name Rast in class 9 has been run; a clean Play search is not trademark clearance.
The 15% service fee, 2% refund allowance and 2% currency allowance are plan assumptions, not measurements taken from this developer account.
